title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam Hoodi testnet launch over security risks

title: Bitcoin Core changes security policy as AI makes bugs easier to find
summary: Bitcoin Core says keeping certain vulnerabilities secret no longer offers much protection in the wake of AI-assisted bug hunting.

title: Switzerland’s first retail spot Bitcoin ETF targets November launch

title: Dune launches real-time data feeds covering 200 onchain trading venues

title: Winklevoss PAC moves into Texas Senate race with $81K ad buy

title: Underdog taps zerohash to bring crypto deposits to prediction markets
